name: Near-dry troughs, Ah = 1.7
setup: IC 2 with huge height waves, Ah = 1.7, so the troughs start at h = 0.3 (training amplitudes were at most 0.6).
expect: Near-dry troughs are where negative water heights appear first. Without a limiter, expect a crash.
observed: The NN alone blows up within the run. MCL-NN keeps h positive throughout and, after the troughs fill in, ends within 0.2% in h.
